description: This file defines a React component that provides a singleton QueryClient context for React Query. It includes utility functions to create and retrieve the QueryClient instance, ensuring it's shared across the application, especially on the client-side.

methods.name: makeQueryClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new QueryClient with custom default options for queries and mutations.

methods.name: getQueryClient
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of QueryClient, creating one if necessary. Ensures a single QueryClient on the client-side and creates a new one on the server-side.
